title: Consolidate condition
why: A complex condition is repeated across multiple locations.
suggestion: Extract a named predicate or document the intentional repetition.
limitations: Repeated byte-scanner cursor conditions are treated as parser mechanics and excluded.
Mechanical shell-completion dispatch is excluded because its repeated conditions are generated from command schemas.
Rust conditions inside comments, string literals and test-only or explicit test-support scopes are excluded using the shared Rust lexical facts.
Conditions are compared within each file; identical predicates across callback or API boundaries still require contextual review.
